caption:
One room, several zones.

Open spaces need structure, not walls. A rug and two low sofas draw the lounge, a recessed line of light marks the dining table, oak-clad columns frame the view, and in an office the lounge, the meeting table and the desk each find their own place, all on one continuous floor.
